Grid.summary: Equal-cell grid container, a LayoutPanel subclass that stretches all children into an evenly sized row/column grid.

props.classname: Class name string, "grid", used to identify the control type.
props.resizeItems: Fixed to true: children are stretched to fill the grid instead of keeping their own size.
props.itemPadding: Cell padding fixed to {0, 0, 0, 0}, so children sit flush against the cell edges.

fileDesc: Defines Grid, a LayoutPanel subclass that stretches children into an evenly sized row/column grid (resizeItems=true, itemPadding 0).
